newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn sets tender to top up New Year Bond-Buba.
newsitem.headline: Bonn sets tender to top up New Year Bond-Buba.

text.p: The German federal government will top up its New Year Bond by up to 10 billion marks this week in an auction with bids from members of the Federal Bond Consortium due by Tuesday, January 28 at 1000 GMT, the Bundesbank as issuing agent said on Monday.
The government earlier this month issued 15 billion marks of the six percent coupon, 10-year bond which matures on January 4, 2007.
The remaining maturity on the paper is nine years, 11 months and four days, the Bundesbank said.
The settlement date on the additional tranche is January 30 and the portion will be included in the stock exchange listing on January 31, the Bundesbank said.
Only members of the Federal Bond Consortium can participate directly in the auction. The bond carries the securities number 113502.
